meta.title: Tent Day in the Hall
meta.textType: story: the theme and the parts

paragraphs: On Thursday, Teacher Kim talked about the next trip in the club hour. "On Saturday, we will have a tent day in the nature park," she said. "Ranger Mark will meet us there." Mia looked at the weather page on the library computer. "It will rain on Saturday," she said. "Then we need some luck," said Leo. "If it rains, we will have the tent day in the school hall," said Teacher Kim. "Please pack a bag with a blanket and a book."

On Saturday morning, the rain fell hard on the roof of the school. The rain did not stop, so the trip to the park was not possible. Everybody came to the school hall instead. Teacher Kim had four tents. Each team got one. The tents were new. They were red, blue, green, and yellow. "Your first job is to put up your tent," she said.

Lily, Mia, Leo, and May began with the blue tent. But there was a problem, because the floor of the hall was hard. "We cannot fix the tent to the floor," said Lily. "Can we tie the tent to the chairs?" asked May. "And we can put our heavy bags on the corners," said Mia. The tent stood up. It was perfect. Teacher Kim clapped. The other teams clapped too.

Next, everybody gave a short talk in the tent. The topic was "Animals at Night." Mia talked about bats, and May talked about frogs. Leo made twenty stars with silver paper. Teacher Kim put them on the ceiling with tape and a ladder. Soon the hall was like a night sky. The rain was noisy on the roof, but nobody minded. Leo smiled, and he said, "This is my best day this month!"

At the end, the children sat in their tents and wrote a letter. "Dear Ranger Mark, it rained today, so we stayed indoors," wrote Lily. "We will come to the park next month." Mia put the letter in an envelope. Lily put a stamp on it. Teacher Kim took it to the post office on Monday. The rain did not stop the fun, and everybody smiled.
